Palabras de Ovidio Reyes Efectivamente. Periodista Erving Vega Ya con dos aos consecutivos, Eso se considera ya con- solidado y con menos riesgo de volver al decrecimiento? Palabras de Ovidio Reyes No solo por el crecimiento heredado, sino porque todos los sectores estn mostrando expansin. Entonces cree- mos que ya tenemos asegurado tambin el prximo ao una continuidad de la expansin econmica. Periodista Erving Vega Y el comportamiento hasta ahorita va conforme a lo proyectado?, o mejor, o un poquito. Palabras de Ovidio Reyes Todo se est cumpliendo como lo esperamos. Es una exce- lente noticia porque nosotros desde el ao antepasado que vimos que la economa venia saliendo de las difi- 4 cultades econmicas generadas por la pandemia, vimos que la fuerza que venia era fuerte, por eso pronostica- mos en su momento un 2021 en positivo y despus un 2022 con una menor tasa de crecimiento, pero consolidada. Recordemos que el 2021 fue ms de un 10%. Este ao es- peraramos que siga expandindose, pero ya una tasa mo- derada . Periodista Erving Vega Nos mantenemos en una proyeccin del 3.5% - 4.5%? Palabras de Ovidio Reyes 3.5% - 4.5%, esa es nuestra estimacin. Periodista Erving Vega Ampliamos el tema ms adelante con el Presidente del Banco Central, Ovidio Reyes. Gracias por continuar con nosotros. Tema central el dia de hoy cierre Cmo cierra nuestra economa? Precisa- mente ya evaluando al final del ao el comportamiento de nuestra economa. Nuestro Invitado el Presidente del Banco Central, Ovidio Reyes, nuevamente Ovidio, gracias por acompaarnos y bienvenido. La primer pregunta con la que empezamos y a manera de introduc- cin bueno Se mantiene verdad el comportamiento de nuestra Economa en sintona con lo proyectado desde el inicio del ao en el Pais. Palabras de Ovidio Reyes Asi es. 5 Periodista Erving Vega 3.5%, 4.5% Palabras de Ovidio Reyes As es, esa es la tasa que nosotros estamos esperando de cierre para el 2022, entre 3.5. y 4.5% de crecimiento; las series que nosotros le damos seguimiento mensual, indi- can que la actividad global viene en expansin, y este ao se encuentra liderada por Hoteles y Restaurantes, el Comercio, Transporte y Comunicaciones, Industrias Manu- factureras . Interesante cmo Hoteles y Restaurantes fue el que ms sufri en la pandemia y ahora es el que va adelante en tasa de crecimiento, 21.9% al mes de Septiembre, y si es el Comer- cio 8.2% y transporte y Comunicaciones 7%. Se observa tambin en la estadstica una recuperacin del arribo de turistas, an no alcanza los niveles pre- pandmicos pero ya se observa un movimiento interesante en esos sectores. Y lo otro es que, todos los sectores: Pesca, Intermedia- cin Financiera, Minas y Canteras, Energa, Agriculturas y otros Servicios de Administracin Pblica, todos vienen cre- ciendo, y eso nos da cierta garanta de que ya Diciembre se va a comportar de manera similar. Periodista Erving Vega Ahora, Qu tan bueno es 3.5%, 4.5% de crecimiento? 6 Palabras de Ovidio Reyes Bueno, cuando lo comparamos con el resto del Mundo es un buen crecimiento, porque el resto del mundo tiene dificultades por razones propias, y el crecimiento va a ser de alrededor del 3%. Entonces si finalizamos este ao en la media de nuestra estimacin que es un 4%, pues estaremos 1 punto por encima de lo que est ocurriendo en el resto del mundo. Periodista Erving Vega Esa es la proyeccin global? Palabras de Ovidio Reyes Asi es, esa es la proyeccin global. Periodista Erving Vega Y ya a nivel de Regin, Latinoamrica y ms reducido todava? Palabras de Ovidio Reyes Andamos por el 4%. Centroamrica siempre ha tenido un desta- cado movimiento econmico relativo al resto de Amrica Latina, quizs es la Regin que mejor ha aprovechado los Tratados de Libre Comercio y la que mejor aprovech el momento de Globalizacin, y se pudo insertar en los mercados interna- cionales; entonces eso le est permitiendo a la Regin entera tener un buen desempeo econmico. En los Indica- dores Econmicos de la Secretaria del Consejo Monetario Cen- troamrica, de la cual Nicaragua forma parte, puede obser- varse cmo todos los Pases de la Regin vamos sincroni- zadamente en recuperacin; sufrimos la pandemia y ahora veni- mos en recuperacin. Y lo mismo ocurre ocn muchas de las variables 7 eocnriicas como muestra de la interrelacin e integracin co- mercial que existe en estos pases. Periodista Erving Vega 3.5, 4.5, se mantiene entonces el ocnportamiento de la Economa en la direccin de lo proyectado. Palabras de Ovidio Reyes Efectivamente. Periodista Erving Vega El tema de la inflacin? Palabras de Ovidio Reyes Bueno, la inflacin es la variable que ha estado afec- tando al mundo entero y que tiene preocupado a los Pa- ses Industriales en primer lugar, porque el origen pues tiene la pandemia como origen, que motiv la expansin mone- taria y la expansin del gasto pblico. Nicaragua no hizo eso, Nicaragua se mantuvo con equilibrios fis- cales y equilibrios monetarios; como resultado de esa gran expan- sin monetaria y de los elevados dficits pblicos se cre una demanda, que por dems era correcto crearla, de lo contrario la recesin hubiera sido ms aguda. Pero la mayor demanda tambin gener irs inflacin y eso es lo que estamos observando; inflacin que se vio recrudecida por los confinamientos porque paraliz el comercio, y adems de eso, quebr ciertos proveedores o grandes proveedores que despus les cost recolocar sus productos. Entonces como consecuencia aumentaron mucho los costos, aumen- t el costo de todos los bienes, de los Insumos, de los 8 Bienes de Consumo, de los Bienes Electrodomsticos, de los Vehculos a nivel mundial, y aument en su momento des- medidamente el precio del petrleo. Lo bueno para nuestro Eis, oono sanos exportadores de Bienes Prima- rios es que tambin subieron los precios del Caf, de la Ganadera, del Oro, de la carne, del Mani, del Az- car, y eso ayud tambin a que el Pais compensara con mayo- res exportaciones. Ahora est ocurriendo un fenmeno un poco a la inversa, despus de que subieron mucho los precios, lo que se observa ahora es que a nivel internacional estos ya vienen hacia abajo. Todava estn altos previo a la pandemia; o sea, todava son precios para nuestros exportadores atractivos, pero ya vienen moderndose. El Caf ha bajado en su precio; baj el Oro pero en las ltimas semanas volvi a subir, y el precio de los alimentos mundiales tambin se ha contenido. Entonces, este ao vamos a ver el efecto del alza de los precios internacionales, y esperaramos que la inflacin se ubique entre un 10 y 11% como resultado de esos precios internacionales. Pero como ya toda la cadena de precios se contuvo y es- t moderando su crecimiento, esperaramos que el prximo ao estos precios tambin en Nicaragua se moderen y se conten- gan, y estaramos proyectando para el 2023 una inflacin que podra estar entre un 5 y 6%; el mundo tambin espera una moderacin de precios. Por el lado de la produccin, nosotros creemos que aun cuando en el mundo no se vislumbran cosas positivas, creen por ejemplo que el crecimiento mundial va a ser ms tmido, y las Economas Industriales van a crecer alrededor del 1% en el 2023; entonces tambin nosotros haciendo una especie de comparacin estaramos en nuestra estimacin creciendo entre 3 y 4%. 9 Yo pensara que si efectivamente el mundo se desacelera tambin esa sera una tasa mucho mejor que el resto, y que nos deja en una posicin de ocntinuar con la expansin econmica que eros estado observando. Pero ahora, los Productores, el Sector Exportador deben procurar tener ms ganancias en volumen de produccin para compensar por la moderacin de los precios. Vemos, no obstante, que contina el crecimien- to econmico y que vamos alcanzar un tercer ao de cre- cimiento para el 2023. Periodista Erving Vega Entre 3% y 4%, 4.5%, sera bueno en trminos, bueno, veni- mos de 3 aos, 2018, 2019, 2020 con decrecimiento, vol- vemos a la senda del crecimiento. Pero Qu expectativa po- demos generar con un 3%, 4%, 4.5% de crecimiento para el gran objetivo de Nicaragua, de seguir avanzando en lucha con- tra la Pobreza. Palabras de Ovidio Reyes Tccb crecimiento positivo se traduce en reduccin de la pobreza y si el crecimiento es mayor que el crecimiento de la poblacin, indudablemente que va a seguir. No se ha hecho un estudio de Pobreza desde hace unos aos, pero por los Indicado- res Sociales que nosotros observamos, la mejora en la co- bertura de telefona, la mejora de los techos en las viviendas, la puesta de ladrillos en las casas, la adquisicin de vehculos automotores, tanto de automviles como de moto- cicletas, y otros indicadores que te miden la capacidad de las personas de mejorar su nivel de vida, nosotros esta- mos observando que efectivamente se viene mejorando el nivel de vida, poco a poco como ocurre, no son grandes saltos, y esperaramos que esta tasa contribuya tambin a la reduccin de la Pobreza. 10 Empleo que es la otra variable clave, el empleo en los ltimos meses se viene recuperando, est reducindose el Sector Informal y est mejorando la formalidad. El Seguro Social est alcanzando ya la cifra de 800, 000 Asegu- rados, y esa es una excelente noticia, porque indica que efectivamente la Economa est soportando la crea- cin de empleo, que ese era un tema que en su momento hemos venido nosotros abordando, puesto que la pandemia dej nue- vas costumbres laborales, y pudo haber afectado en el mo- mento en que ocurri la bsqueda de empleos, y de hecho lo hizo. Y por eso es que Indicadores como la tasa de participa- cin laboral se redujeron, pero ya con la nueva dinmica nuevamente se est volviendo a la contratacin de em- pleo, y creemos que eso va a continuar y va a ubicar la tasa de desempleo alrededor de un 3% para el prximo ao como va a ocurrir tambin durante el presente. Periodista Erving Vega Cmo ha sido el escenario internacional, favorable, desfavorable este ao para la Economa, y cmo se proyecta para el prximo ao? Palabras de Ovidio Reyes Como los bienes de los productos que nosotros exportamos se mantuvieron bien altos el escenario fue favorable; no fue tan favorable en trminos de expectativas porque hubo mu- cho ruido de problemas comerciales, problemas geopoliticos, y sobre todo de las polticas de alzas de tasas de inters que endurecieren las condiciones financieras . Eso motiv tambin a que nosotros, el Banco Central, conti- nuemos ajustando las tasas de inters en respuesta a las alzas de las tasas de inters a nivel mundial. Ayer tambin hu- 11 bo tambin otro movimiento en la tasa de inters, y lo ms probable es que nosotros tambin lo hagamos, no podemos an- dar alejados de esa realidad. Pero a pesar de ese escenario tan complicado que se vislumbr durante este ao, los productos nuestros encontraron salida, el Mercado Regional demand ms productos nicaragenses alimenticios. Podra decir sin temor a dudas que nos estamos volviendo a posicionar como un proveedor de alimentos regional con mucha capacidad de llevar granos y productos como la carne y la caa de azcar y otros bienes, que en las condiciones actuales hemos visto que es una gran forta- leza, ya que no todos los Pases tienen esa capacidad de producir su propio alimento. Nicaragua si ha logrado generar mucha capacidad, y lo ms importan- te es que se contina expandiendo. Entonces aun cuando ese es- cenario estuvo un poco complicado, el Pais si respondi positivamente porque nuestros bienes tuvieron buenos precios y encontraron salida. Por eso nosotros insistimos, cuando comenz esta mejora de los precios internacionales, que iba a ser una oportunidad para capitalizar al Sector Primario, y poder generar mejoras tecnolgicas y mejoras en los mtodos de produccin, para que los aumentos de productividad sean los que determinen hacia adelante la produccin de Nicaragua. Y creo que en eso el Pais lo est logrando. Periodista Erving Vega Para el prximo ao el escenario se pinta bien, o repre- senta cierta amenaza para el Pais? 12 Palabras de Ovidio Reyes Pareciera ser que para el prximo ao la actividad econ- mica va a ser menor que este ao que finaliza, al menos eso es lo que dicen los Organismos Financieros Internacionales, que nosotros les damos seguimiento. Pero nuevamente, ni en la pandemia que hubo una ruptura del comercio interna- cional nuestras exportaciones dejaron de crecer, y que hubo una recesin mundial, y sin embargo, nuestras exportaciones avanzaron. Porque es una realidad, la necesidad de alimentos va a existir siempre y Nicaragua esa es su especialidad, produ- cir alimentos, y la Zona Franca producir Bienes Industria- les, pero los nicaragenses, lo que tienen capacidad es de producir alimentos. Entonces creemos nosotros que vamos a estar bien posi- cionados y que vamos a salir adelante, no vemos en ese escenario internacional algo que nos vaya a limitar. Porque nuevamente, aun cuando los precios han bajado en los ltimos meses, de los bienes internacionales, todava se encuentran ms altos que en la pandemia. Entonces hay un incentivo para producir. Periodista Erving Vega Desde el punto de vista de los andamiajes, los soportes de nuestra economa interna, cmo estamos en ese sentido? Palabras de Ovidio Reyes Bueno, Es una buena noticia lo que est ocurriendo en el Sector Financiero la expansin del crdito que hemos venido observando. La pandemia tuvo el inconveniente de que gener mucha incertidumbre, y los Bancos mostraron mucha cau- tela en la entrega de los crditos. 13 Pero ya ahora esa incertidumbre ha disminuido bastante, han habido excelentes noticias que han movilizado nuevamente el entusiasmo en el Sector Financiero, como la ltima evaluacin del Fondo Monetario, la mejora de la calificacin internacional para Nicaragua que hizo Standard & Poors; la salida de la Lista Gris de Nicaragua, del OXEE, y todas esas oosas movilizan expectativas y fi- nanciamientos, y eso ha hecho tambin que el crdito vuelva a reactivarse. Nosotros esperamos que esa expansin que estamos obser- vando en el crdito contine con ms fuerza durante 2023, y que sea tambin un factor que contribuya internamente a garantizar la expectativa de crecimiento que tenemos. Lo otro que hemos estado observando es que, la inversin ex- tranjera nacional est agarrando buena posicin, y por lo tanto est reinvirtiendo mucha utilidad, y adems se est expandiendo plantas. Eso es otro fundamento que nosotros creemos le va imprimir dinamismo asi como la recuperacin que estamos espe- rando en el Sector Turstico, tambin va a agregar nuevo im- pulso . Entonces, vemos que en general no hay ni un solo sector que nos d muestras de debilidad; al contrario, la econcmia entera se ha fortalecido y se desenvuelve con plena normalidad. Periodista Erving Vega Las variables digamos que determinan la sanidad, la so- lidez o no de una econcmia, cmo est; estamos hablando de reser- vas, por ejemplo, cmo estn, qu nos refleja? Palabras de Ovidio Reyes Bueno, los depsitos vienen creciendo en positivo, es un tema estructural que al nicaragense ya ahora le ha 14 agarrado gusto al ahorro; o sea, eso es muy bueno, por- que el financiamiento propio es todava ms sano que el internacional. Periodista Erving Vega Est creciendo el ahorro? Palabras de Ovidio Reyes S est creciendo el ahorro, pero es interesante que el ahorro no dej de crecer durante la pandemia, ms bien se con- solid, y ahora est expandindose, no ha dejado de hacer- lo; y como deca, es ms sano incluso que el financia- miento internacional, que los prstamos y todo lo dems, porque es de fuente propia. Entonces la base de ahorro nacional contina expandindose, es un excelente indicador incluso de confianza de los depositantes y de todas las Empresas e Instituciones que ponen su dinero y sus recursos en el Sistema Financie- ro . El otro indicador importante es la expansin de la base mo- netaria, la base monetaria contina creciendo y cuando crece, crece porque el Sector Financiero o vende dlares al Banco Central, o el Sector Pblico tambin aumenta sus de- psitos, y eso hace que haya ms capacidad o ms demanda de dinero; cuando hay demanda de dinero entonces el indicador va ex- pandindose. Se observa una continuidad que viene bsicamente determinada por la demanda, y como consecuencia de ese mayor requerimiento mone- tario y del mayor ahorro vanos Reservas Internacionales consolidadas de alrededor en este mes, el da de ayer estaban en 4,260 millones de dlares. 15 El Banco Central comprando dlares en la Economa, es un fenmeno bastante interesante, porque hace unos 3 aos el Banco Central siempre venda dlares a la economa, pe- ro desde hace dos aos y medio casi, el Banco Central no compra un solo dlar en la economa, no coloca un solo dlar en la economa. No vendemos un solo dlar, todo lo con- trario, solo hemos comprado dlares, por eso estamos acumulando muchas Reservas; es decir, tenemos una buena oferta de divisas que no demanda ya del Banco Central una intervencin. Eso es muy positivo, esa es una excelente seal de que hay condiciones para que incluso se produzca una mayor esta- bilidad cambiara. Entonces vemos que el mercado de divi- sas se encuentra en equilibrio y bien fondeado, con recursos provenientes de las exportaciones, de la inversin extranje- ra, de las Remesas, del Turismo, que mantienen lubricada a la actividad comercial. Y por el otro lado, vemos un balance fiscal estable, Finanzas Pblicas con gran recaudacin, ms de 2 dgitos la recauda- cin; tasas que llegaron al 30% de recaudacin, ahora se estn moderando alrededor de un 20%. Y eso, como el ahorro es sano para el Sistem Financiero, la recaudacin tambin es sana pa- ra las finanzas pblicas porque no es endeudamiento, son recursos propios de los nicaragenses que se relocalizan y que tambin dan muestras de fortalecer el movimiento de actividad econmica. Entonces vemos finanzas pblicas con deuda pblica es- table y un dficit controlado entre un 2 y un 3%, que eso en cualquier pas del mundo es envidiable. Esas dos condiciones, equilibrio monetario y cambiarlo con reservas internacionales consolidndose, y un dficit pblico con deu- da pblica controlada, incluso reducindose como porcenta- je del PIB, y recaudacin fuerte, nos dan elementos pa- ra pensar de que la actividad econmica est sobre bue- 16 nos cimientos financieros, y por lo tanto va a continuar en expansin durante 2023. Periodista Erving Vega Tengo una segunda pausa, vamos a regresar con las con- clusiones de Ovidio Reyes, Presidente del Banco Cen- tral, volvemos. Estamos conversando esta maana con el presidente del Banco Central, Ovidio Reyes. Scbre el estado de la Econcmia, el comportamiento de la Economa al cierre de este ao 2022, faltan todava 16 dias de Diciembre, 16 dias intensos desde el punto de vista del Comercio principalmente. Comercio y Turismo, verdad? Pero bueno, el dato que nos ha compartido Ovidio es que estamos cerrando en linea con lo proyectado entre un 3.5% y un 4.5% de crecimiento. Vol- vemos a la ruta de crecimiento del ao 2021 con un 10.3% y este ao con un 3.5, 4.5%, y la proyeccin para el prximo ao de un 3%. Palabras de Ovidio Reyes Entre 3 y 4%. Periodista Erving Vega Esto es bueno tomando en cuenta que estamos creciendo ms que la mayora del resto del mundo. Qu tan slido es para mantenernos en esa ruta de crecimiento para los prximos aos? Palabras de Ovidio Reyes Cuando la actividad comercial y la actividad productiva ya encuentran el rumbo es muy difcil detenerlo, esto es 17 como cuando uno quiere mover un objeto grande con rue- das, cuesta mucho empujarlo, pero una vez que lo empu- jas detenerlo es un poco difcil. Lo mismo pasa con la Economa, tom su tiempo empujarla, cost; entre todos em- pujamos la Economa y ahora ya tom vuelo. Entonces no va a producirse una desmejora de la noche a la maana, adems, no existe un elemento as de riesgo tan pronunciado que lo indique. Los riesgos que nosotros hemos estado viendo a nivel macro- econmico son de orden financiero, por ejemplo, la ltima al- za de las tasas de inters podran en su momento, y si llegan a ser muy pronunciadas, afectar la actividad econmica glcbal. Pero en Nicaragua no representa una amenaza seria, nosotros subimos la tasa de inters en Nicaragua, para evitar tambin la fuga de capitales. Porque si el mundo entero est subiendo la tasa de inters y nosotros no lo hacemos, puede irse plata hacia afuera. Periodista Erving Vega Pero repercute en el crdito a su vez de forma negati- va, no? Palabras de Ovidio Reyes Pues. Hasta ahora no lo ha hecho tan fuerte, es pequeo y entiendo la posicin banquera, porque despus de ve- nir de una crisis en que perdiste muchos clientes y uno se pone a afectar mucho la tasa de inters, pods volver a perder los clientes, y nadie quiere eso. Entonces hay mu- cha prudencia en la Banca, por no trasladar los costos internacionales al crdito, pero no est dicha la ltima pa- labra; sin embargo, hay un esfuerzo mundial por contener la inflacin, eso s, y los movimientos en las tasas de inters moderan la expansin monetaria. 18 Periodista Erving Vega La inflacin que probablemente al observar es quiz la nica nota alli en negativo, verdad? porque pasar a dos dgitos significa un golpe, yo diria un golpe significa- tivo en la economa domstica. Palabras de Ovidio Reyes Siempre los ajustes de precios no son bienvenidos, pero recordemos tambin, que la produccin necesita precios, cuando uno lo ve por el lado del productor, mejores precios incentivan ms produccin; si lo ves por el lado del consumidor es negativo, te afecta tu bolsillo. De he- cho hay cal y de arena en esto que est ocurriendo, asi como los exportadores se vieron incentivados, los consumi- dores resienten un poco el alza de los precios. Pero, no obstante, lo que vemos es que se estn moderando, que los precios internacionales dejaron de crecer, se estn estabilizando, y veramos nosotros el prximo ao un des- censo de esos crecimientos. Quizs, creo yo, en este ao que ocurre ms que al consumidor, creo que aqui a quien ms afect el alza de precios es a los materiales de cons- truccin, muy fuerte el alza, y es que muchos materiales son importados tambin, los switch elctricos, cosas de electrici- dad, bienes para producir materiales tambin son importados, luminarias, etc. Y la construccin est resintiendo las alzas tambin, y se observa en las estadsticas, que el sector Construc- cin est siendo un poco ms prudente. Nosotros creemos que eso detiene Proyectos; por ejemplo, si se sube mucho el precio del material de construccin y un Proyecto estaba esperando cierta rentabilidad, el alza de los precios ya no es la misma rentabilidad. 19 Lo que ha habido un poco es eso, postergacin de Proyectos esperando mejores condiciones, pero despus de ese sector que particularmente viene afectado por el alza de los pre- cios, vemos que el resto de sectores est creciendo. Por ejemplo, es cierto, suben los precios, pero el Comercio est creciendo en trminos reales un 8%, en trminos nominales el crecimiento es casi el 18%, o sea, que el resto es precios. Entonces, aun asi hay comercio, an asi hay movimiento de la Infraestructura, de Transporte, y creemos que en ese sentido las alzas de los precios, si bien es cierto han afectado el bolsillo, pero no han paralizado la actividad econmica, o sea, ella contina. Porque est este otro factor, hay buenos precios, hay que ganar ms en el lado de los Productores. Asi es que, apartando el tema este de los precios pero vien- do que no han sido un impedimento para la expansin pro- ductiva, nosotros vemos que el resto de actividades van a continuar a cano lo estamos observando aqui en el ndice Mensual de Actividad Econmica, van a continuar en expansin y van a seguir generando empleo. Periodista Erving Vega Ya para cerrar, a manera de tus conclusiones, estamos de nuevo en la ruta del crecimiento, hay polticas econmicas, hay comportamiento social que es determinante. Cules se- rian las recomendaciones qu debemos hacer, para que efec- tivamente una vez que empujamos la carreta, no solo no se detenga sino que podamos hacer que vaya ms rpido? Palabras de Ovidio Reyes Yo creo que hay un elemento importante en todo esto, los Economistas, y muchos le llaman expectativas, y se- 20 gn como uno se forme la expectativa del futuro, el ca- rro sigue. Y lo cierto es de que, para lo que ha ocurrido este ao, se han creado expectativas positivas; es decir, la gente se puso a trabajar, el sector se movi, todos los sectores se movieron, y cuando hay actividad se crea esa expectativa, y la expectativa te lleva a tomar decisiones de consumo y de inversin. Entonces este elemento de generar polticas econmicas que abonen en las buenas expectativas, creo que es un elemento importante que se ha estado haciendo. Nosotros desde nuestro mbito hemos estado promoviendo eso, las Instituciones del Gobierno tarrbin desde su rrbito desde el Sistera Nacional de Produccin, Consumo y Comercio vienen gene- rando Capacitaciones, entrenamientos, programas para generar este ambiente productivo, este ambiente de trabajo que todos los nicaragenses lo necesitamos para continuar saliendo adelante y lograr el objetivo principal, que es la reduccin de la Pobreza. Periodista Erving Vega Muchsimas gracias por habernos acompaado. Ovidio Reyes, Presidente del Banco Central.

Title: Interview with Comrade Ovidio Reyes, President of the Central Bank of Nicaragua, with Journalist Alberto Mora, Live Magazine, Channel 4
text: Interview with Companero Ovidio Reyes President of the Central Bank of Nicaragua with Journalist Alberto Mora Live Magazine, Channel 4 August 17, 2022 Journalist Alberto Mora Well, dear viewers, we welcome the President of the Central Bank, Companero Ovidio Reyes. Thank you for being with us, Ovid, and joining us this morning. Words by Ovidio Reyes Good morning. Journalist Alberto Mora We have known, throughout the course of the year, that the behavior of the economy is quite positive; that is, the indicators give us good numbers, both numbers and percentages, and in that sense I would like you to give us, for our audience, our television friends, an X-ray of what the economy is at the moment: How we are doing in exports, the effort that is also made with the Reserves, what has to do with the different export items, also the issue of inflation, the issue of slippage, monetary security, monetary stability, and also a little about Remittances. Welcome, Ovid. Words by Ovidio Reyes Good morning, Alberto, thank you for inviting me to this Program. Good morning to the public who listen to us and watch us on television. The economy has been reacting positively after the pandemic; in fact, the whole of Central America. The Dominican Republic and the countries near the Region, Panama, have evolved quite quickly, confronting all the problems that derived, both health and economic, from the pandemic, and that paralyzed services, trade and many activities. Nicaragua stood out in the sense that export activity was not paralyzed, nor food production activity, nor agricultural production activity, and that made it easier for the country to continue accumulating resources, strengths, and that the economy, after the pandemic, grew by 10% last year, of course, it is a fairly high rate. Journalist Alberto Mora We've never reached 10, have we? Words by Ovidio Reyes No, but we were coming from a moment of activity writing because the confinement or the slowdown that occurred in many of the activities, especially service, for fear of contagion, that reduced income; But then came that rapid, very rapid recovery of the economy, and now in 2022 we are growing, but at a more moderate rate. I'm going to give you data, for example. Today the Central Bank is going to publish the Monthly Index of Economic Activity for the month of June, it would already be the end of the First Semester, and the data that we are going to present is that, as of June, the economy is already growing in the accumulated, in economic activity, 4.9%. That means that in terms of Value Added we are growing at 5%, as of June; 10% to 5% is still a very positive rate, I use the "very positive", because really 5% in a world that is slowing down strongly, is a very good rate. And by Sector what does this mean? That Agriculture grows at 2.9% as of June and that the sector that is growing the most is the Hotel and Restaurant Sector by 20.1%; then, the Commerce Sector by 9%; Transportation and Communications by 5.7%; Mining and Quarrying, 9.5%; Manufacturing Industry, 6.5%, and Financial Intermediation at 4.5%. It is important to see that while the post-pandemic economic dynamism was resting on the Primary Activity Sectors, now, after the landing, let's say, of the economy, it is the Trade, Service Sector, which is now rebounding and has been the most punished previously. But what we observe is that the economy is responding well, and then when we analyze the set of Summer Indicators that it is, and then we would expect this behavior to continue. The landing could be at the end of 4% of the year, and that is why we the Central Bank, since the beginning of the year, estimate economic growth for Nicaragua in 2022 of between 4 and 5%, and we maintain this estimate until the information tells us otherwise; but we are facing a positive year in terms of economic growth. Journalist Alberto Mora Now, as for the Ovid items, how do we go there with meat, gold...? Words by Ovidio Reyes Well, the main beneficiary, let's call it that, beneficiary of growth is employment, because as there is growth, employment is generated. Also today the INIDE is going to publish the Quarterly Report of the Employment Survey, and that indicates that the unemployment rate has also been improving, it has been falling therefore, and will end the Second Quarter at a rate of 3.1%. It is a very low unemployment rate. Journalist Alberto Mora Do you no longer divide it into open, underemployment, you no longer have that category? Words by Ovidio Reyes Yes, it can be done and in fact in the INIDE Statistics it is presented, and it is observed that the underemployment rate is sometimes known as Informal Employment, but underemployment has also been reducing; that is, the reduction in the unemployment rate has been occurring due to the improvement of Formal Employment and the reduction of Informality. Journalist Alberto Mora How many more have signed up for Social Security so far this year? Words by Ovidio Reyes So far this year, the total is around 780,000 jobs, more or less, and the number of Insured has increased by about 40,000 jobs. We would expect that to continue. In fact, Formal Employment has seasonality, that is, there are months when it goes up, down, due to the characteristic of our economy that has 20% of the Agricultural Sector and in the bulk of the harvest then more people are employed and there it increases. There are seasonal elements, but by isolating elements of these seasonalities, formal employment has been recovering. So, the first Impact Indicator of these Statistics that we have presented on Economic Activity is employment. Employment is advancing; Of course, one would like it to advance at a faster speed, but in the current economic conditions it is a good speed that leads to recovery. After the pandemic, things happened, Alberto, a little confusing, in the sense that they have not been able to be explained well with respect to employment, because before the pandemic many people speak in the labor market, after the pandemic in the whole world there were fewer people in the labor market. Journalist Alberto Mora You mean the PEA, which they call it, right? Words by Ovidio Reyes Exactly. In other words, many people left the labor market and that is a phenomenon that has happened here in Nicaragua, it happened in Central America, it happens throughout the world. There is a lot of economic research, an answer has not yet been found, it is also a mystery. It could be that the pandemic itself led families to stay at home, to work from home, to do Entrepreneurship from virtual means, to conduct business from home, that is, to locate in small businesses. There are many factors behind it. But there is activity, that is, it is not that this reduction, the people who left the labor market reduced economic activity. No, economic activity continues. But well, that is an issue that will be seen later. Then, when we look at the disaggregated indicators, what we see is that export activity continues with that strong dynamism until the month of July, with total exports growing by 16% in volume, and then the sectors that have been ahead have been the Gold, Coffee and livestock sectors. However, I have to emphasize that the Industry Sector has also increased its exports, of course, not to the levels of these first 3 products that I mentioned, but they have found the entire manufacturing sector, leaving its production abroad, Central America and other countries. So we believe that this export activity will continue for a fundamental reason, and that is that international prices are excellent. Journalist Alberto Mora In terms of volume, 16% growth, and in terms of prices? Words by Ovidio Reyes In volume, total production, in the amount grows by 16.3%; in volume, which is quantity, it grows by 2.6%. 0 is, we continue. Journalist Alberto Mora It's the other way around, 16.3% is in amount, you say the opposite, but well, and 2.6% is in quantity, in volume. Well, will we manage to maintain those prices next year? Uncertain, isn't it? Words by Ovidio Reyes That does not depend on us. Coffee is more than 200 dollars a quintal; Gold, 1,800 dollars a troy ounce, there are excellent prices for livestock, for all products, but it depends on international conditions, it does not depend on Nicaragua. And the truth is that prices throughout the world have moved upwards, all of them, food goods, raw materials, inputs for production, all have had significant increases and that has affected the entire price chain throughout the world. They are high now, but they could go down for other reasons. We can speculate what you want, but the truth is that they are high and that is motivating more exports. Journalist Alberto Mora And in terms of export amounts, where are we going right now? Words by Ovidio Reyes We believe that we could reach, without any problem, 3,000 million dollars of exports for this year, and more; without Free Trade Zones, if you already incorporate the Free Trade Zones, we are talking about 7,000 million dollars of exports. These are important amounts that will come to fund the entire country. In fact, the country's funding has been reasonably good, in a context in which international interest rates have been rising; The United States raised its interest rates, the European Union, the European Central Bank raised its interest rates, the Bank of Japan raised interest rates; that is, all the countries of the planet have moved interest rates, Central America has raised interest rates. And that has a problem, when the interest rate rises a lot, the financial cost of credit becomes more expensive. To some extent it benefits depositors because it improves yields a little, but especially in such large economies they absorb a lot of capital from the rest of the world when interest rates rise. And that is the problem with rising prices, that it can lead to a tightening of monetary policy in the rest of the planet. But well, this phenomenon does not occur in the summers so that with these interest rate hikes, the international monetary authorities expect world inflation to slow down, and that could affect exports because those prices could fall, but there we are in a terrain that we have not yet calibrated well. We believe that commodity prices will be maintained; In our estimates we see commodity prices that remain at attractive levels so that the volume of production continues to be offered abroad; that is, we do not see a rise in exports; on the contrary, we see a continuity of that movement. Journalist Alberto Mora Now, in terms of domestic financial activity: Deposits, Monetary Stability, Placement of Credits, some sectors say, well, I have the possibility of financing; there is also an effort made by the government in Small Enterprises, and there is also capitalization there. But in general terms, the financial situation? Words by Ovidio Reyes The Financial System, as I mentioned here, in real terms is growing financial intermediation by 4.5% as of June, which means that there is movement of financial activity. It was quite depressed last year, despite the economic recovery of economic activity in general, but already this year the Financial Sector has once again catalyzed and mobilized resources. In the first place, deposits have not stopped growing, which is a very positive phenomenon that the Financial System has managed to attract resources to the banks. In fact, as you mention, it is an element of confidence in financial stability, and when there is confidence in financial stability, people come to the bank and deposit their resources. That growth in Deposits has been high, 18% growth, and there is no sign that this will be reduced. And therefore, the Banks managed to accumulate sufficient resources, both liquid resources and investment, to the point that this year bank lending activity has been reactivated. Now, in this reactivation, the Commercial Sector, Canercio, in the Statistics of the Superintendence includes all the Commercial and Industrial activity, it is the one that is growing the fastest, a little less fast in other sectors, but we see that now we have, unlike last year, a much greater credit activity, and we hope that this will be consolidated. Non-performing loans have been reducing and bank profitability is in acceptable terms, which has allowed all institutions to find themselves with very high levels of sustainability, and to also collaborate in this environment of recovery and economic growth. As a result, we do not have any financial imbalance in the economy, there is exchange rate stability, the exchange rate flows freely, free purchase and sale of foreign currency in important areas, which have allowed the accumulation of International Reserves. We have many more international reserves today than we had before the pandemic and even before the socio-political events. We have 4,300 million dollars of International Reserves; these are amounts strong enough to sustain this economic result and the Financial System in general. Journalist Alberto Mora Could I explain to my viewer friends how the International Reserves play out, and what it represents for the Economy. Ovid, we are going to talk about different aspects, but I would like you to tell us, what do the International Reserves represent for the Economy? Words by Ovidio Reyes International Reserves are an indicator of a country's strength, because to the extent that it has significant amounts, to the same extent it has a greater capacity to resist events, and they are called Reserves, because they are there to confront events, and are used when they occur, in eventual situations, during convulsive situations or natural events. In fact, as part of these Reserves, the General Treasury of the Republic also deposits enormous resources in the Central Bank to confront it, and the Central Bank uses it in situations of financial instability. Also to cushion the imbalances that can occur in the Mercado Cambiarlo; when there are imbalances, the Central Bank injects dollars and then that stabilizes. So, that is what it means to have International Reserves in significant amounts, the country is in a better condition to withstand events. Journalist Alberto Mora Now, the calculation of the employment rate, unemployment... How do you calculate the Economically Active Population (EAP)? Words by Ovidio Reyes Well, there are statistical methods to estimate it, by age, for example... Journalist Alberto Mora That is, the range of people who can work, let's say. Words by Ovidio Reyes That's right, exactly. But in summary, in the calculation of the total population that is about 6.3 million inhabitants, there are people who do not work for reasons: either they are children, or they are already retired, they are people who can no longer work or who are sick, for multiple reasons, and what results is something that is known as the Economically Active Population. which is around 3 and a half million inhabitants in Nicaragua. Of those 3 and a half million inhabitants, these people are looking for work or are working; Of the 3 and a half million inhabitants, those who are looking for work, those are known as the unemployed, and that is how we calculate the unemployment rate. Journalist Alberto Mora But if you see it only by Social Security then it would be serious, right? Words by Ovidio Reyes No. Journalist Alberto Mora Because, well, I was just looking at it, well, those who are working are 780,000 of those 40,000, the rest are not working. Words by Ovidio Reyes No; the rest are working, that's right. Journalist Alberto Mora In the Lfercado he has I don't know how many people are working. Words by Ovidio Reyes  not all of them are in Social Security, many people buy Optional Insurance there. So when we talk about employment, we talk about the employment of people, or those who are looking for work or who are working; then the unemployment rate is calculated from there. Journalist Alberto Mora  there is a lot of Enprendimiento that is not in the Social Security and that is being generated every month. Words by Ovidio Reyes But in the Survey carried out by INIDE, it is measured, the household that is interviewed and there is an Entrepreneurship is measured as part of the active population, and as an employee. Journalist Alberto Mora Now, on the subject of inflation, you were talking a little about the situation in the world. How are we doing with the issue of inflation, the exchange rate, the exchange rate, the slippage that is called it? As far as I understand there is stability in the exchange rate, and there are countries that are terribly affected. Words by Ovidio Reyes We have an Exchange System that I think has favored because it does not generate so much uncertainty, of how much the exchange rate will be tomorrow and when the exchange rate will be in a year even, because we announced an annual sliding rate of around 2%. Other countries have flexibility to exchange it and the exchange rate has skyrocketed to very high levels, and that has had an impact on prices, because when the exchange rate moves, prices also suffer. Journalist Alberto Mora Now, there's also a lot of responsibility here for not using the machine, isn't there? Words by Ovidio Reyes We don't use it that way you might think, not at all, but it's done with asset backups. If the Banks and the Treasury take the assets to us, then we deliver the money, if not, no. For example, if they take us the dollars that is an asset, we deliver cordobas, if not, we do not do it; if they bring us a strong asset that is also financial, we deliver the cordobas. That is the way it has to be supported. Every cordoba that is on the street is supported, it is backed and it is also backed with Reserves, which is the important thing. In fact, in our statistics it is observed that the ratio of our Reserves, of support to the cordobas is 2 point 8 times; that is to say 2 point 8 times reserves to support Cordoba, it is over-supported, but if we can support more, better jor. But, returning to the issue of prices, since exchange stability is assured, the issue of prices is an issue that comes, in the case of Nicaragua that has affected it, it comes from outside. It is a phenomenon, or an experience that we experienced for the first time at the national level, in the sense that before all price imbalances in Nicaragua were internal, they occurred in Nicaragua, but now all the imbalances and to a large extent it is from abroad. But now all the price imbalance is coming from outside; that is, inflation is high. For example, yesterday it was announced that in the United Kingdom inflation reached 10.1%; in the United States inflation is above 8%; in the European Union it is well above 8% and reoesicn, as you mention; or economic stagnation. Well, we also have high inflation as a consequence of that, since our economy is very open; we have exceeded 10,000 million imports between the Free Trade Zone and the rest of goods, and Exports reaching 7,000 million dollars; that is, the amounts of trade here are large, very large for the economy. And therefore, everything that happens with external prices impacts the national production chain, and that is what has happened. Journalist Alberto Mora But some prices that depend on us are maintained, right? Words by Ovidio Reyes Some prices are maintained, but the truth is that prices have moved, we cannot deny that reality; in the Statistics there it is clear the inflation that INIDE has just reported, the latest inflation, prices moved again. But there is an element that we believe is emerging as a signal, the prices of raw materials, including oil, stopped the rise at the international level. Journalist Alberto Mora But there is also the issue of the subsidy that the Government applies to prevent things from getting worse. Words by Ovidio Reyes Of course, we are going to go to that, that is the internal element, but the relevant external element is that prices at the international level kind of took a big leap and stayed there, some have even dropped their little; for example, Oil showed signs of downward direction. But well, in the world you know what does it like this, it goes up, down, up, down. But we believe, and at least in the various analyses that we carry out of international monitoring, that they reached their maximum and that they are going to stay there. If that is the case, we should expect a Second Semester in which inflation will begin to subside, it will begin to land at less dramatic levels, like what is happening at the moment. What can we do to combat that? I am very frank about this, it is very difficult for us to do something because it does not depend on us, it comes from outside; if the prices of Urea rise in the world, what can we do? if the price of fuel rises in the world, if the price of food in the world rises, the price of clothing... because the entire chain has really been moved by multiple factors. After the Coronavirus, everything became more expensive as a result of transportation costs rising a lot. In addition, there were obstacles, trade was paralyzed in many regions of the world; So, what we can do to stop that pressure is very difficult, it is very little, but we can compensate. Journalist Alberto Mora But there is also abuse on the part of some who take advantage, they give it a speculation a higher than it should be. And in the case of the Producers, it is also known that there are efforts on the part of the Institutions that are in charge of it, to review things and tell the Producer, maybe you don't need so much of this fertilizer, but you need a little less. Words by Ovidio Reyes They look for alternatives and change methods. Journalist Alberto Mora That doesn't change the price, I'm clear, but in some way it's palliative help. Words by Ovidio Reyes It helps mitigate. So, just as things can be mitigated at the microeconomic level, as you are mentioning, it can also be done at the macro level, such as the fact, for example, of the decision of the President in coordination with the Ministry of Finance and Public Credit, to allocate resources to subsidize fuel. That is a measure that has helped a lot, and it seems that because of what is happening in terms of the drop in prices it was the appropriate one, to prevent prices from rising a lot and then falling a lot. It is not true that prices go down a lot, it is very difficult, once someone has acquired a price the seller will not lower it so easily because lowering it makes him lose profit and market. Journalist Alberto Mora Of course, only when they are stationary products, when there is a lot of supply and suddenly there is no more. Words by Ovidio Reyes You noticed, Alberto, that during the pandemic the prices of the restaurants did not vary at all and the clientele stopped arriving, but the prices were still there. This is a rather strange phenomenon, one should say: they should go down, but they didn't come down. The same thing happens with many products such as hardware stores, it is very difficult for a hardware product to go down, it goes up but when it has already gone up it does not go down again; so in some way this transitional subsidy measure helps and will also help to have more stability in prices. Journalist Alberto Mora Now, the Tourism Sector is expected to contribute more because you spoke of a hotel growth of 20%, so it is expected that there will be an important contribution at the time of calculating. Words by Ovidio Reyes We would see, for example, that this year there would be a recovery of Tourism and that it is around 400 million dollars compared to how very bad it was last year in terms of Tourism, and that is being observed in the Statistics of Hotels and Restaurants that are growing significantly. Journalist Alberto Mora But not only for Nicaragua, that is, there are countries that even closed and said, no one enters here. Words by Ovidio Reyes That's right. Now, those countries that depended only on that, no way had to open, but in our case that we have diversification in all sectors, in the Primary, Secondary and Service Sectors, in our case the reactivation of Tourism has been a little more moderate, but the important thing is that it is coming, and it is being fully observed in the statistics. We are talking about a growth of 20.1% in that sector in relation to last year, and that is an excellent rate; in fact, when we review the sales volumes, in all sectors it is clearly observed that what corresponds to the Commercial activity, Supermarket activities, Commerce activity itself, is growing. Journalist Alberto Mora Without using any formula, just observing, I can assure you that when you pass by some places they are always full, and I say, well, there are no rials and all the people are here; it is a popular saying. Words by Ovidio Reyes It's a popular saying, people say, and even I've said it: how come there is no money? and the restaurant or the entertainment center is full. But that is good because recreation, entertainment for 2a farrilia is healthy, ocntribcye a lot to economic activity in general. Journalist Alberto Mora .. and also the insane, hehe. Words by Ovidio Reyes I'll leave that to you... (laughs) Journalist Alberto Mora Is Remittances Currently Growing? Words by Ovidio Reyes Yes, Remittances, like other activities, have had a very large rebound, more than 30% growth, in the last Report that we published on Remittances during the year 2022, and it is in the order, closed number, of 1,400 million dollars that entered from Remittances in the First Half of 2022 in Nicaragua. That is an extremely important amount, that points us multiplying by two, 2,800 million dollars in Remittances; Many factors contribute to this. There is also an inflationary element in Remittances, if prices in general are rising and growing, a lot of money because it has to be sent, compensate prices, but it does not matter, the issue is that there is a significant volume of mobilization of resources. Now, there are countries in Central America that are exploiting in Remittances, not only Nicaragua, Guatemala, El Salvador and Honduras are having spectacular reserves, Honduras in this first half of the year 2,800 million dollars, they are huge numbers. The Dominican Republic and countries that did not receive as many remittances are beginning to receive them such as Costa Rica and Panama. It is important how this dynamic of remittances is stimulating commercial activity in our countries, because many of these remittances go to low-income families and as soon as the remittances arrive, they are destined for consumption, the vast majority is destined for that. Well, and then there are Ventures to be able to mobilize those resources from the Financial System to Projects. Journalist Alberto Mora Well, tell me a little about public revenues, Ovid. Words by Ovidio Reyes Well, the statistics that the Ministry of Finance and Public Credit has sent us is that tax collection is positive, there has also been a rebound in collection as in the rest of the chain of economic sectors, and that they would expect to end up with quite important figures for this year. So far, no indication of a significant slowdown in these indicators is observed in the statistics of the Ministry of Finance. Journalist Alberto Mora Only one year there was a backward reform, the only year, the year of the coup attempt and you pointed it out in that obviously planned encirclement, and you mentioned the economy. At that time I remember that some awkwardly said that it was not the important thing; however, then so much damage was caused that we also had to face that blow that was hard; Ivan Acosta has said that it was even harder than the effect of the pandemic, but for the first time there was a backward reform. Because there was always a Reform, let's say in the last quarter of the year, for the Budget, I am referring to the Budget Reform, which was to redistribute resources. Is it very possible that this year will also happen? You don't have the magic ball but if you see the numbers maybe and hopefully to allocate more resources for the public function. Words by Ovidio Reyes Well, I am going to appeal to the years I worked in the Ministry of Finance, as an Advisor in the Ministry of Finance and Public Credit. And yes, every year the Ministry of Finance and Public Credit promotes a Budget Reform after the First Draft Budget. For a practical reason, the Budget is formulated and presented in October of the previous year and approved around November or December. Then, as that happens six months, the formulation . In fact, at this time the Ministry of Finance is in the formulation of the Budget, it happens six months before the beginning of the year, and when the year begins things change, the evolution, the speed changes, the budgetary requirements change, more resources arrive, some are canceled. So when there are changes in the assumptions that give rise to our budgetary forrulation, then it is logical that towards the second half of the following year there will be budgetary adjustments, and in fact they have occurred, if you review every year they occur. As they happen every year, I think it should not happen this year. So, I believe that the Minister of Finance will value and recommend to the President a Reform for the economic performance that has been observed, and for the fiscal performance mainly. Journalist Alberto Mora All the indicators are good, the percentages are good, the projection remains 5%. Words by Ovidio Reyes 5% uplift and continuity of exports, continuity of the pace of investment; we do not talk about Foreign Direct Investment, but I have to say that Foreign Direct Investment continues to be positive; we believe that we are going to be above 1,000 million dollars this year, last year it was around 1,300 million dollars, and we believe that this will be repeated this year, and that the country continues to present a promising scenario. Journalist Alberto Mora I thank you, thank you very much for coming.
text_original: 1 Entrevista al Compaero Ovidio Reyes Presidente del Banco Central de Nicaragua con el Periodista Alberto Mora Revista En Vivo, Canal 4 17 de Agosto del 2022 Periodista Alberto Mora Bien amigos televidentes, le damos la bienvenida al Presidente del Banco Central Compaero Ovidio Reyes. Gracias por estar con nosotros, Ovidio, y acompaarnos esta maana. Palabras de Ovidio Reyes Buenos dias. Periodista Alberto Mora Hemos conocido, a lo largo de lo que transcurre del ao, que el comportamiento de la economa es bastante positivo; es de- cir, los indicadores nos arrojan buenos nmeros, tanto nmeros como porcentajes, y en ese sentido quisiera que nos pudie- ras hacer, para nuestro pblico, los amigos y amigas tele- videntes, una radiografa de lo que es la economa en este mo- mento: Cmo vamos en exportaciones, el esfuerzo que se hace tambin con las Reservas, lo que tiene que ver con los dife- rentes rubros de exportacin, tambin el tema de inflacin, el tema de deslizamiento, la seguridad monetaria, la estabili- dad monetaria, y tambin un poco sobre las Remesas. Bienveni- do, Ovidio. Palabras de Ovidio Reyes Buenos dias, Alberto, gracias por invitarme a este Progra- ma. Buenos dias al pblico que nos escucha y ve por la te- levisin. 2 La econcmia ha venido reaccionando positivamente despus de la pan- demia; de hecho Centroamrica entera. Repblica Dominicana y los Pases cercanos a la Regin, Panam, han evolucionado de una manera bastante rpida, confrontando todos los proble- mas que se derivaron, tanto de orden sanitario como de or- den econmico, de la pandemia, y que paralizaron los servicios, el comercio y muchas actividades. Nicaragua se destac en el sentido que no se paraliz la acti- vidad exportadora, ni la actividad de produccin de alimentos, ni la actividad de produccin agropecuaria, y eso facilit que el Pais continuara acumulando recursos, fortalezas, y que la economa, despus de la pandemia, creciera un 10% el ao pasado, claro, es una tasa bastante alta. Periodista Alberto Mora No hablamos llegado nunca al 10, verdad? Palabras de Ovidio Reyes No, pero cano venamos de un momento de redaccin de actividad por- que el confinamiento o la desaceleracin que hubo en muchas de las actividades, especialmente de servicio, por miedo al contagio, eso redujo el ingreso; pero vino esa recu- peracin rpida, muy rpida, de la economa, y ahora en el 2022 estamos creciendo, pero ya a una tasa ms moderada. Te voy a dar por ejemplo datos. Hoy el Banco Central va a publicar el ndice Mensual de Ac- tividad Econmica al mes de Junio, ya seria el cierre del Primer Semestre, y los datos que vamos a presentar es que, al mes de Junio ya la economa est creciendo en el acumu- lado, en actividad econmica, 4.9%. Eso significa que en trminos de Valor Agregado estamos creciendo al 5%, al mes de Junio; de un 10% a un 5% contina siendo una tasa muy positiva, utilizo el "muy positiva", porque realmente un 3 5% en un Mundo que se est desacelerando fuertemente, es una tasa muy buena. Y por Sector qu significa esto? Que la Agricultura crece a 2.9% al mes de Junio y que el sector que ms est cre- ciendo es el Sector de Hoteles y Restaurantes en un 20.1%; luego, el Sector de Comercio en 9%; Transporte y Comunicaciones en 5.7%; Explotacin de Minas y Canteras, 9.5%; Industria Ma- nufacturera, 6.5%, y la Intermediacin Financiera en 4.5%. Es importante ver que mientras el dinamismo econmico post- pandmico estuvo descansando en los Sectores de Actividad Primaria, ahora, despus del aterrizaje digamos de la econo- ma, viene siendo el Sector Comercio, Servicio, el que aho- ra est repuntando y que habla sido el ms castigado previa- mente. Pero lo que nosotros observamos es que la economa est respondiendo bien, y luego cuando analicemos el conjunto de Indicadores veranos que asi es, y esperaramos nosotros entonces que este comportamiento contine. El aterrizaje podra ser al final de un 4% del ao, y por eso es que nosotros el Banco Central, desde inicios de ao, estimamos el crecimiento econmico para Nicaragua en el ao 2022 de entre 4 y 5%, y mantenemos esta estimacin hasta que la informacin nos indique otra cosa; pero estamos frente a un ao positivo en trminos de crecimiento econmico. Periodista Alberto Mora Ahora, en cuanto a los rubros Ovidio, cmo vamos ahi con carne, oro...? text: TRANSCRIPTION TRANSCRIPTION Master of Ceremonies Master of Ceremonies Mario Benavides, Chemical Engineer Mario Benavides, Chemical Engineer Master of Ceremonies Master of Ceremonies Questions and answers from participants of the Business Forum: Outlook, Economic Development and Food Security 2022-2026 We are going to take advantage of a maximum of 10.15 minutes to ask four questions to Ovidio Reyes, please we are going to give them the microphone, so just raise your hand, we send them the microphone and you can ask your question. Good morning, my name is Mario Benavides, a chemical engineer and I work in the environment and I am precisely very interested in the issue of economic recovery and all this. But my question is basically aimed at whether the issue of the environment will still be seen as the Cinderella of the gear. And I bring this up because precisely with the new law 620 of water and now with the conversion processes that the National Water Authority has had, precisely the issue of water, which is a finite resource and that positions us in a privileged position worldwide and we must not lose the point of view and perspective. Thanks a lot. We took the four questions and then addressed the Answer, please. Arturo Fonseca, Microfinance Collaborator Good morning, my name is Arturo Fonseca, I work for a microfinance company. We give credit to agricultural production, pilgrimage, coffee, cocoa, basic grains, and in many areas of the interior of the country. And we have noticed what Mr. Reyes says that the agricultural sector is actually a strength. We have observed that livestock has grown steadily, cocoa production has increased, rice production, the production of tubers, vegetables, corn, beans has also improved, that is observed without the need to be an expert. But, nevertheless, that has a cost and the cost is environmental cost, that is, for agricultural expansion and agricultural growth to continue in Nicaragua and to be able to really be sustainable and make a contribution to the economy, it needs investments in environmental compensation that TRANSCRIPTION TRANSCRIPTION Ronald Blandon Ronald Blandon Good morning. My name is Ronald Blandon and I work with the primary sector, specifically livestock. Thank you for the invitation to this forum. As comrade Ovidio said, the primary sector has been able to respond to all the vicissitudes we have gone through. And more than just another question, it is a request to the highest representative of the government that the technical work commissions that we had several years ago that really bore a lot of fruit be reactivated. Ovidio is a witness to this, to the meetings we had and how we systematically met with representatives of the different levels of government and together, the private sector and the public sector we were able to take giant steps, which we have had practically almost four years of not being able to meet and I believe that the livestock sector has much more to give for this nation. Thanks a lot. TRANSCRIPTION TRANSCRIPTION Master of Ceremonies Master of Ceremonies Leonel Agurcia Moneada, President of the Federation of the Chamber of Livestock of Nicaragua Good morning, I am Leonel Agurcia Moneada, I am the President of the Federation of the Chamber of Livestock of Nicaragua, affiliated to APRODESNI and I represent about 56 chambers of cattle throughout the country and with about 3,500 affiliates. We have listened carefully to the presentation of Mr. Ovidio, where he recognized that we ranchers have really been moving the economy forward with our own resources. And precisely now we have been struck by an offer that CABEI is announcing for loans to the sector, but we are concerned that when these loans arrive at a second-tier bank, the interest rates rise enormously. In this way, it is very difficult for us to compete with other countries as cattle ranchers and to get ahead and build our farms, to continue improving. And that is why the livestock sector, almost with its own resources, has been working. If you see, last year more than 200 million dollars were left for credits that were not used precisely for that, for the credit. The banks have always been arguing about the risk factor, which is false, here everyone and even the livestock sector has been paying. So, we wanted to ask you, let's say, to see how the Central Bank influences these banks so that we, the cattle ranchers, can opt for those loans and that fair interest rates really come. Thank you. Nestor Espinoza, Forum Participant To be quite positive, very optimistic about the results of 2022, when in the face of the crisis caused by the West's sanctions on Russia, practically everything has risen to us, food and energy. You said that this inflation in some way benefits our producers, in the sense that they are paid a better price, mainly for what we are producing in food. Yes, but the producer is also paying a higher price for all the inputs he needs to be able to produce. So, their profit margin, their profit margin, has not risen in the same way that the price could have been raised. How will it impact? It is already impacting Nicaragua. To begin with, President Ortega said a week ago, 4 to 6 million dollars a week are being used to subsidize fuel costs. That is TRANSCRIPTION TRANSCRIPTION President of the BCN President of the BCN 4 or 5% this year? I believe that issues that are related to the environment are always relevant issues. The financial system, including CABEI, today has financing that gives it the title of "green", in the sense that to provide it, a set of actions that are friendly to the environment have to be developed and thus the funds are provided, everything that contributes pays. Unfortunately, we in the race, that of caring for the environment, we reached the end, because when we arrived and they began to put restrictions on us, all the others already burned everything they could, they burned the carbon they could, they already destroyed the forests they could, they already did everything, they already soiled the sea. Because Nicaragua is really very little in pollution, in fact. We are a net producer of oxygen. Those who have made these calculations for our forests and for our way of life, and you put in all the carbon production of Nicaragua, industrial vehicles and everything else, and we come out winning. And yet, we have to take action. It's a bit unfair because if after everything they did in the world and Nicaragua wants to develop, why can't it do it the same as the rest? So, now we have to adopt measures and that means more expensive production, because really getting into environmental issues with those of the Law means developing a lot, a lot of technology, to compensate for it. It must be done! But, for this, it would be necessary to design plans and programs for clean production or low-carbon production, how is that done? Well, we as an institution bank are not dedicated to that matter, in fact, that is what Marena is for, that is why other institutions are in charge. On the financial side, what is done is that, programs and policies are promoted to support green financing, as it is known, and that means better interest rates and better conditions for producers. TRANSCRIPTION TRANSCRIPTION The government has promoted many programs to improve animal, pork, agricultural technologies, production methods that allow us to do more with the same or add little and get more, all of that is a measure of productivity. And yes, we have to worry about producing more because otherwise we would not be able to achieve higher yields or higher incomes. The balance between income and what it costs, I think that at this time it is in favor of what comes in. In fact, GDP is that. GDP is the measure of value added, that is, income minus cost. That is what economic activity measures. It also measures the effective production of products. How many heads of cattle are there, how many new quintals of products or how many new tons of product exports? But, in the end, what matters is the added value. Admission, less cost. And in that balance we continue to be positive. In other words, that 5% growth that we are observing today is that income minus cost is positive at 5%. If the volume of production is higher, the added value is what in the end economically matters. Because if the added value is negative, you will most likely close your business. If your income is greater than the costs, then you move forward, but if they are lower, see you, you close the business. So, in economics that is what is done, the added value is measured, the income, in other words, the income produced by economic activity. The whole world increased costs and companies had to adapt to those costs or have had to adapt to those costs and pass it on to prices. And that is the inflationary impact, (but) on the net it is still positive. On bank financing. Look, credit structures are diverse, they respond, above all, I think, to risk and portfolio management expenses, those are the main components of the interest rate. Where there is a higher interest rate is because there is either greater risk or there is a higher cost of administration, and in that sense the issue of productivity also comes up, because if administration costs go down, the interest rate can go down and if the risk goes down, interest rates go down, these are the two fundamental elements. Is TRANSCRIPTION TRANSCRIPTION The ROE and ROA of banking institutions are all similar, even similar to those of other institutions that are not necessarily banking. So, there's a balance of performance. How can the interest rate be improved through banking? I think, when we look at the average interest rates, (that) we have improved them. If you look at the statistics, the average interest rate, both active and passive, has been falling. That is the contribution we can make. Now, the business decision of a bank or a microfinance institution or a financial institution of how much it is going to charge is a private decision and the user's decision to make it is a private decision, merely. But, if we see with the policy that we have been implementing, achieving a reduction in interest rates, but now with the world raising rates we will see how it behaves going forward. Finally, I am speaking with realism rather than optimism. Because sometimes they tell me: you are optimistic; Well, you're pessimistic, I tell them. But it's not about telling us those things, right? I remember that in 2018-19 I had to say that the economy was going negative and they were going to tell me: now you are pessimistic: No! that's what we were seeing. Now what we are seeing is that the economy is doing well, that we are coming out of the difficult moment and that we are growing. Last year we recovered a lot, we grew at 10.2%. Well, this year we are stabilizing and we are growing between 4% and 5%. They are realities, that is what we are trying to explain and project. Risks, as I have already mentioned, in this reality there are risks. Risk that international prices will not give way and continue to rise. There is a latent risk that interest rates will rise, capital will leave and that will affect us. It is latent, the risk of climate change is latent. There is the Minister in a race because the hurricane is coming, that is latent. What do we do? But it is on paper, and on computers, we pretend that if all these risks arise, the interest rate rises, the price of oil skyrockets, there are problems in the supply chain, there is a lack of food, with certain reasonable margins, and what they give us is that the economy is strong. Could growth slow? Yes, it could, it could. It depends on the nature of the impact that arrives and the intensity with which it arrives. For example, the two hurricanes hit us. The two hurricanes of 2020, at the end of 2020 impacted us, generated a drop in economic activity of around 1.4%, but we recovered. Apart from the fact that in the 21st quarter the first quarter had a large spending program to promote the TRANSCRIPTION TRANSCRIPTION Well, thank you very much. Well, thank you very much. But, we are in June, we are halfway through the year and we prefer to maintain our estimate. Perhaps by October we will have a better image and stronger statistics of how the year will end definitively. But, at this date we believe that it is prudent and that it is reasonable, rather than prudent, to maintain our estimate (of growth) between 4% and 5%. Now, in the end it is an issue of employment and it is a matter of dynamics, and as long as employment continues to grow, we are doing well... We are doing well. Social Security attracting more insured people. And in the employment measurements of the Nicaraguan Institute for Information and Development (INIDE), employment is increasing. So, we are in good dynamics and that generates more income and that generates more economic activity. As I mentioned, what we observe is that in this round of recovery the favored in the first round: the primary sector. In this second round, the primary sector is maintained, but new actors are entering: commerce that had been hit during the pandemic and the socio-political shock is now in full recovery. The hotel and tourism sector is recovering and with the data I gave you, it is certain that tourism is advancing again. The service sector, the communications sector, the transport sector, the same. And in this first quarter the private construction sector stands out, the public construction sector fell a little because the first quarter of last year, as a result of the investment that was made to counteract the impact of the hurricanes, this first quarter is lower and comes out negative, but it is not that it is bad, the recovery projects of the first quarter (of last year) are simply not there, but the private sector does observe how buildings and construction are growing, they are facts and we hope that those facts are sustained and fulfilled.
