Title: Interview with President Ovidio Reyes R. on La Notificacion Program, Channel 8
text: TRANSCRIPTION TRANSCRIPTION Issuing confidence and stability Issuing confidence and stability Interview with President Ovidio Reyes R. in Program La Notificacion, Channel 8 Topic: Foreign Investment and Economic Prospects November 4, 2023 Journalist Oscar Morales Welcome. We are back with you. An increase in foreign direct investment in this Central American country has been confirmed and exports could also have a new record at the end of 2023. Both pillars are fundamental to Nicaragua's economic growth. To address this issue we have invited the President of the Central Bank of Nicaragua, Ovidio Reyes, whom we thank for having heeded the invitation once again here in La Notificacion de TN8. President, welcome. President of the BCN, Ovidio Reyes R. Thank you very much for the invitation. Journalist Oscar Morales I begin by asking you, what is the reason for this increase in the flow of international money to do business in Nicaragua? President of the BCN, Ovidio Reyes R. The Nicaraguan economy has been showing signs of an economic rebound after the pandemic and this has accelerated. So, with this economic growth and with more business opportunities, it is natural for companies to reinvest and in addition to that make new expansion of plants, equipment, machinery to be able to participate in this growth. So, that is the reason that is pushing behind, the reactivation of foreign investment. TRANSCRIPTION TRANSCRIPTION Issuing confidence and stability Issuing confidence and stability It is synonymous with trust. President of the BCN, Ovidio Reyes R. Of course, because there's nothing better as a sign of confidence than putting your money to work. And there are significant amounts that have occurred. Journalist Oscar Morales According to the report that circulated this week, there is a fairly significant percentage increase in foreign investment. President of the BCN, Ovidio Reyes R. Yes, it's pretty important. For example, we are coming from a 2020 in which foreign investment due to the conditions of the pandemic and because the world slowed down, the risks increased, as it was a modest amount. In our records we reached 435 million dollars of foreign investment in 2020, but since then the amounts have been growing. In 2021 it reached 144 million dollars*, in 2022, 1,122 million dollars and now in the first half of 2023, 1,447 million dollars. In other words, based on the last four years, foreign investment has been increasing, it has been growing. Journalist Oscar Morales Which countries do these funds come from and which specific sectors are leveraging it? President of the BCN, Ovidio Reyes R. Yes, well, businesses in Nicaragua are made up of residents and non-residents. It is known as foreign investment, the non-residents who arrive and install their plants here and begin to carry out operations. So there are two components: the investment, when it arrives, which consists of an X amount of money and then the investment that the company has to continue making, because it has to renew equipment, it has to expand production, it has to expand plants and that investment, the reinvestment, is the one that has been having the most effect. *Errata: The correct figure is 844 million dollars. TRANSCRIPTION TRANSCRIPTION Issuing confidence and stability Issuing confidence and stability Journalist Oscar Morales And if foreign investment increases, is there more employment? President of the BCN, Ovidio Reyes R. Of course, because all economic activity is carried out by people and that undoubtedly brings and leads to the hiring of not only more direct jobs that they require, but also of all the recurring jobs they need, such as the contracts they make with transport companies, such as services that entail insurance, financial services, etc. logistics services to be able to mobilize all these resources. Then a current is generated that boosts employment. Journalist Oscar Morales Now there is more investment, obviously it is also leveraging the growth of the construction sector, which was in a depressed moment, but we have seen a rebound. President of the BCN, Ovidio Reyes R. That's right, construction was depressed because with a pandemic all prices suffered increases and it is understood that a business that had a project at a certain cost and faces an increase in all the prices of construction materials, which reached up to a 40% increase, the project has to be reviewed. So, many projects went on hold because costs increased, not only because of the cost offered by the construction, but also because of the demand. So they had to redefine strategies so as not to pass on these costs all to the consumer. And well, that moment has passed, the economy has adjusted, they adjusted, they restructured costs, and now with the new prices they are offering investment goods and it has accelerated. So, this is very positive because consumption has always remained growing, even with the pandemic and investment has been depressed, but the good sign is that it has been reactivated and that is pushing the Monthly Index of Economic Activity during the last few years. TRANSCRIPTION TRANSCRIPTION Issuing confidence and stability Issuing confidence and stability Journalist Oscar Morales Mr. President, and these new investments are not only concentrated in Managua, but we see new industries, for example, in the Caribbean, and that also leverages the economic dynamism of that sector. President of the BCN, Ovidio Reyes R. That's right, because investment reaches several sectors. There is investment from free zones, but there are also investments outside the free zone in industry, in the fishing sector, in the agricultural production sector, for example, the dairy sector, it receives a lot of support from foreign investors who are practically suppliers and stockpilers who take the products abroad, because we have a surplus of milk production and meat production. milk and its derivatives cheese, and there are surpluses in meat production and then all that is taken advantage of by investors. So it is transversal and not to mention the transport and communications sector, which here there are many cargo and freight companies that are dedicated to this activity and are foreigners. Journalist Oscar Morales Now let's talk about the increase in exports of goods. According to the data that the Central Bank was sharing this week, an increase of more than 1,700 million is reported compared to 2022 President of the BCN, Ovidio Reyes R. That is equivalent to a growth of 6 and 6.5%. Yes. There is a combination of price improvements, but also an increase in quantity. The whole world went into a slowdown. In fact, global growth is expected, that is, poor, at 1.5%, especially in industrial economies. But Nicaragua has not fared so badly, despite this slowdown. Interest rates in the world rose, which cooled the markets and the local conflicts of other countries have prevented trade from flowing in the best possible way. But even with that low demand, Nicaragua has managed to place its goods and that is positive and especially agricultural goods that are growing. Perhaps the one who has suffered the most from this effect has been the Free Trade Zone, because as it is an issue of global demand, especially in terms of harnesses, clothing, the products that are manufactured there, that has affected them. Although not all, because the tobacco found there, in the Free Trade Zone, is expanding and growing. But agricultural goods continue to expand and so do those that come from the industrial sector that processes TRANSCRIPTION TRANSCRIPTION Issuing confidence and stability Issuing confidence and stability Journalist Oscar Morales And another sector that we see quite dynamically now is tourism. Could we have an increase in foreign currency in this area? President of the BCN, Ovidio Reyes R. Yes, tourism is growing by 10%, that is, a fairly important boost. Last year we ended with 597 million dollars in tourist income, from tourism. This year we would expect about 600 (million) at this growth rate, about 650 million dollars more or less, which could come in. The arrival of tourism is also accompanied by an increase in demand for hotels and also for restaurant services. And this is also observed when one reads the reports of economic activity that the hotel and restaurant industry sector is expanding at rates of more than 20%. Journalist Oscar Morales Mr. President, what could the construction of these seven megaprojects in conjunction with the People's Republic of China mean for the country in terms of economic growth: modern airport, railways, first-world roads? President of the BCN, Ovidio Reyes R. Yes, in our growth models all new investment pushes, this increase in foreign investment is pushing the economy and the return of construction and undoubtedly that the incorporation of new projects, will also give a boost to economic activity. How much? Well, that will be seen when the amounts, execution deadlines, etc., are already defined. At this time, we do not have it incorporated into our estimation system. In other words, if the economy is growing at a rate of 6%, (inaudible) it will undoubtedly win. Journalist Oscar Morales How will the economy move right now in the month of November and December, with the delivery of Christmas bonuses, the arrival of remittances and (inaudible)? TRANSCRIPTION TRANSCRIPTION Issuing confidence and stability Issuing confidence and stability The Christmas holiday months are months when the boost in commercial activity and recreational activity, especially service activities, is noticeable. And the Christmas bonus gives an economic boost to the national economy, increases the monetary base; We observe that, in that, from the beginning of the delivery of the Christmas bonuses - which begins at the end of November - the monetary base grows a lot, which is natural. It is a cycle that we call seasonal. So we would expect that restaurant, hotel, recreational activity and commerce in general will benefit from the Christmas boost. And as they know every year, all the businesses are waiting for him to take advantage of that moment and be able to make all the inventories they have there, waiting for the customers who are going to arrive this season. Journalist Oscar Morales Are the growth prospects for 2023 maintained? President of the BCN, Ovidio Reyes R. In the last review we did and published, we went from a growth of between 2.5% and 3.5% to between 3% and 4%. Depending on what happens in the measurement of economic activity for the entire quarter, because we only have August and September so far, and what ends October looks very good, we would see if it is necessary to make another correction, because it seems that the economy is being closer to 4 than 3 of the range; But that is something that we are going to confirm with the final data. We remain in positive territory that we are going to achieve good economic results. Journalist Oscar Morales And for 2024, President? President of the BCN, Ovidio Reyes R. In 2024 we believe that this momentum will be repeated. We believe that there are conditions for growth to stabilize at no less than 4% and so we have in the medium-term estimates, the economy growing 4, 4.3, 4.5. Journalist Oscar Morales And the vast majority are waiting for that January 1, 2024, when the dollar practically comes to a standstill. TRANSCRIPTION TRANSCRIPTION Issuing confidence and stability Issuing confidence and stability The dollar is not going to move, at least the official one, because the economy is really free, the exchange rate is freely determined on the street. What the Central Bank does is that it announces an exchange rate that is above all for the adjustment of value maintenance in the banking system and for the Central Bank's foreign exchange purchase operations, but after that it is free. But what we have observed is great stability, that is, all financial operators, the money changers take as a reference the exchange rate announced by the Central Bank and the difference is minimal as 0.2%. There is not much difference. Journalist Oscar Morales Mr. President, Nicaragua has all the conditions. Can any company sell, buy and immediately start operating? President of the BCN, Ovidio Reyes R. That is maintained. We have not changed that policy, the policy of free convertibility, that is, the investor brings his dollars, sells them freely in the market and then buys the income that produces dollars freely in cordobas. Journalist Oscar Morales And we have a fairly robust financial system at the end of 2023, with all seven banks operating in Nicaragua. President of the BCN, Ovidio Reyes R. This is because the deposits and savings of Nicaraguans continue to expand, the rates are greater than 10%. And on the other hand, credit, which was quite depressed after the pandemic, has already been reactivated. Already this year the credit deliveries have been regularized. If one reviews the financial and banking statements and what is published by the Superintendency of Banks and the Central Bank, they have been improved. The profitability index of banks has improved. Journalist Oscar Morales Anything you would like to add in conclusion, President? TRANSCRIPTION TRANSCRIPTION Issuing confidence and stability Issuing confidence and stability Well, the message that appropriate conditions are being generated for businesses to function, for the economy to fully develop, to exploit the economic potential that our country has, which is quite great. I have always said it, we have a potential and we have great strengths that make us relatively withstand any onslaught of internal and external or natural imbalance. Today we are better prepared for a natural problem even, but we cannot be confident. So we have to continue accumulating savings, we have to continue accumulating those energies to help the economy grow. So an invitation for everyone to get in tune with the fact that there is an expanding economy at this time and put forward their creativity, entrepreneurship and those who already have established businesses to continue their goal. Journalist Oscar Morales We are left with that phrase, "Expanding economy". Thank you, Mr. President, for joining us, here in La Notificacion.

Title: Press Conference Report on the Results of the Meeting of the National System of Production, Consumption and Trade President of the BCN, Ovidio Reyes R.
text: PRESS CONFERENCE REPORT OF THE RESULTS OF THE MEETING OF THE NATIONAL SYSTEM OF PRODUCTION, CONSUMPTION AND COMMERCEPRESIDENT OF THE BCN, OVIDIO REYES R. 06/11/2023 President of the BCN, Ovidio Reyes R: Good morning! We are going to present the results of the meeting of the National System of Production, Consumption and Trade that we have just ended today, Friday, November 3, 2023. As on previous occasions, in the National Production System, we see the progress of the production of specific items and we also touch on general elements of economic evolution. In a recent report made by the Central Bank, the month of August 2023 continued to reflect what we have been presenting in previous reports, which is the progress that has been observed and the good economic performance that we are seeing during the second half of the year. It is accumulated from the variable of the Monthly Index of Economic Activity, a growth between January and August 2023 versus January-August 2022 of 4.3%. This is good news because the Central Bank revised its target towards growth between 3% and 4% and, in light of the new information, it seems that the result is closer to 4% and it is a good behavior that is being observed in all economic sectors, mainly in the energy and water sectors. hotels and restaurants, commerce, construction and exploitation of mines and quarries. These are the sectors that are driving the economy, in addition to financial intermediation and transport and communications. In other words, we are having a good moment in the economy that is being reflected in greater trade and a boost in the consumer sector. If we look at it on the side of economic activity, the same, all sectors are expanding, except for fishing and aquaculture and, slightly, the livestock sector, which is already beginning to improve, which had its cyclical effects, which we explained on previous occasions the origins. On this occasion, at the meeting of the System, we entered into the issue of fisheries and aquaculture production, which was observing a cumulative decline, but that growth rates are getting better and better, that is, less negative so far this year. Even from a production goal that we had set in the plan of 109 million pounds, 122 million are already being reached. In other words, with respect to the target, we are finishing better than we had expected, at a decelerated rate, but better, that is, a growth of 11% compared to the goal we had set ourselves. Compared to the previous year, however, I mentioned, we are having a lower production. Last year to January-September 131 million pounds had been produced. This year we have 122 million, but better than we had expected. We expected a more negative rate, but we are already seeing a rebound and in particular the production of farmed shrimp, lobster, pink conch and scale are having good results. Likewise, tuna production has been accumulating 33.5 million pounds produced and the landing of lobsters has had a boost. Last year, for example, 3.3 million pounds were being produced in July-September and in July-September of this year, 4.1 million pounds are being produced for a growth of 26%, which are helping to compensate for the declines in the other items. On the other hand, you know that the System not only sees figures, but also programs that are being pushed to support production and 1,720 productive fishing bonds have already been delivered, or will be delivered, both in the Autonomous Region of the North Caribbean and the South Caribbean; a total of 861 bonds in the North Caribbean and a total of 859 bonds in the South Caribbean, for an advance of 82% of the goal. Likewise, work has been done with the emergency response project to hurricanes and lines of attention have been drawn up for the fishing sector for 4.3 million dollars to reach 6.3 million dollars, especially in the qualification of artisanal fishermen. On the other hand, an evaluation of what is the strategy for the production and promotion of small-scale aquaculture is carried out. This consists of reservoirs that are pushed from small enterprises. To date, there are 903 families benefited. 70,032 fingerlings have been delivered to 911 ponds. 59,551 pounds have already been produced, an 88% compliance with the goal, and it would be expected to reach 67,878 pounds in 963 ponds. That is the advance of small-scale production and the advance of fisheries production, which, as we mentioned, is having a lower incidence rate compared to the cycle that occurs in fisheries and aquaculture production. Fisheries exports are already performing well. Last year, 249.6 million dollars had been exported and this year 207 million dollars are already being exported, that is, trying to reach the goal of 2023. The other topic we addressed during the meeting was the strategy for the promotion, production and marketing of honey. As you know, the INTA is pushing the promotion and training for honey cultivation. MEFCCA, as well as IPSA, work directly with this strategy. 12,941 trainings were carried out for producers in flora of interest, preparation of complementary feeds and bee breeding, this was carried out by the MEFCCA, and 201 protagonists trained in the implementation of good manufacturing and hygiene practices for bee production and marketing, which promoted the IPSA. On the other hand, 3,192 protagonists strengthened in value addition to their beekeeping products, export procedures and product safety, an activity that was promoted by the MEFCCA. From the IPSA, 427 protagonists trained in these practices, 95 samples for disease monitoring, 2,127 producers trained in honey production, 23 municipal technology fairs in which 345 producers participated. And from the MEFCCA also, enterprises that participated in expo productive fairs in different products; jelly, liquors, gastronomy, cosmetics, crafts, etc. And there, with 6,500 protagonists served from the MEFCCA. In the inventory, there are 48 technified apiaries installed with 48 registered producers, 834 hives, mainly in Leon, Boaco, Jinotega, Matagalpa, Rivas and Esteli, and 786 producers registered under the aquaculture entrepreneurship system in the MEFCCA. In terms of production, total honey production reached 1,036 metric tons so far in 2023. Last year it was 690 tons to date and 864 metric tons of honey were exported compared to 576 last year. In other words, the attention that is being given to it by institutions and the promotion of bee honey production is having the expected results. On the other hand, we evaluated the national strategy for the production of vegetables in arbor crops, an activity carried out by INTA, three centers specialized in vegetable production in San Isidro, Jinotega and Esteli. There is an annual goal of reaching 47 experiments and investigations, already established in 40 experiments. There is an 85% advance in research on the cultivation of different vegetables, which are basically tomatoes, chiltoma, cabbage, cauliflower, pipian, squash, onions, broccoli, watermelon and another set of vegetable products. In terms of seedling production, which is a main activity, to be able to provide healthy and high-yielding seedlings, there is a goal of reaching the production of 600,000 plants. And there is good news, 1,617,000 plants have been produced in different vegetables and crops and arbors, for a fulfillment of 269% of the goal. There are 8.42 manzanas established for the adoption of seeds registered in tomatoes, onions, chiltoma, squash and pipian. These are the activities that are promoted by INTA. Work is also being done on new varieties of vegetables, in 44 varieties, in alliance with international centers in Costa Rica, Chile, Argentina and Mexico. And on the other hand, in training, which is always an intense activity carried out by the institutions, 77,286 training and technical assistance have been carried out, a total of 5,620 trapping services on vegetable producers' farms and 379 trapping services in passion fruit, flower bud and 622 trapping services in fruit flies in the sweet chili category. On the other hand, 2,704 events have been held, including regional fairs and peasant markets, with the average participation of 3,284 protagonists. This is what has been done from the promotion of vegetables, vegetables and arbor crops. Finally, we looked at the state of price developments in general. We see that prices have had lower growth than those observed last year. On average, the price growth rate is approaching 6% year-on-year. Last year it was 11%, that is, we have half of last year's inflation. That is also good news, and the prices of the products in these months, with the departures of the harvest, we hope that this stabilization of prices in general will also continue. Finally, INETER made the weather forecasts. On the INETER website you can find all the information regarding the climate. However, INETER reported that for the next two weeks the rains will continue due to a low pressure center that is located on the Caribbean coast. However, in the assessment we made of how this could affect production, we believe that these rains are not going to affect production, as harvests begin after November 15. This is in summary what we discussed at the meeting of the National System of Production, Consumption and Trade and there is a growth in economic activity in a good perspective at the end of the year, an advance in the recovery of the negative fishing rate that we would expect to end with a lower incidence for the rest of the year. good honey production, in fact a substantial increase in honey production, and an advance in the production of vegetables and branches with prices that tend towards stabilization. That was the summary of the meeting. Thanks a lot! Have a good day.

Vamos a presentar los resultados de la reunin del Sistema Nacional de Produccin, Consumo y Comercio que acabamos de finalizar el da de hoy viernes, 3 de noviembre de 2023. Como en ocasiones anteriores, en el Sistema Nacional de Produccin, vemos el avance de la produccin de rubros especficos y tambin tocamos elementos generales de la evolucin econmica. En un informe reciente que hizo el Banco Central, el mes de agosto de 2023 continu reflejando lo que hemos venido presentando en informes precedentes, que es el avance que viene observndose y el buen desempeo econmico que estamos viendo durante el segundo semestre del ao. Se acumula desde la variable del ndice Mensual de Actividad Econmica, un crecimiento entre enero y agosto de 2023 versus enero-agosto de 2022 del 4.3%. Eso es una buena noticia porque el Banco Central revis su meta hacia un crecimiento entre 3% y 4% y, a la luz de la nueva informacin, parece que el resultado est ms cercano al 4% y es un buen comportamiento que se est observando en todos los sectores econmicos, fundamentalmente en los sectores de energa y agua, hoteles y restaurantes, comercio, construccin y explotacin de minas y canteras. Esos son los sectores que estn empujando la economa, adems de la intermediacin financiera y el transporte y comunicaciones. Es decir, estamos teniendo un buen momento de la economa que se est reflejando en un mayor comercio y en un empuje del sector de consumo. Si lo vemos por el lado de la actividad econmica, igual, todos los sectores se encuentran en expansin, salvo la pesca y acuicultura y, ligeramente, el sector pecuario que ya comienza a mejorarse, que tuvieron sus efectos cclicos, que explicamos en ocasiones anteriores los orgenes. En esta ocasin, en la reunin del Sistema entramos en el tema de la produccin de pesca y acuicultura, que estaba observando una baja acumulada, pero que cada vez las tasas de crecimiento son mejores, es decir, menos negativas en lo que va del ao. Incluso, de una meta que nos habamos puesto de produccin en el plan de 109 millones de libras, ya se van alcanzando 122 millones. O sea, respecto a la meta, estamos terminando mejor que lo que habamos esperado, a tasa desacelerada, pero mejor, es decir un crecimiento del 11% respecto de la meta que nos habamos propuesto. Con respecto al ao anterior, no obstante, les mencion, estamos teniendo una produccin menor. El ao pasado a enero-septiembre se haba producido 131 millones de libras. Este ao llevamos 122 millones, pero mejor que lo que habamos esperado. Esperbamos una tasa ms negativa, pero ya estamos observando un repunte y en particular la produccin de camarn de cultivo, langosta, caracol rosado y escama estn teniendo buenos resultados. Asimismo, la produccin de atn viene acumulando 33.5 millones de libras producidas y el desembarque de langostas ha tenido un empuje. En el ao pasado, por ejemplo, se estaban produciendo 3.3 millones de libras en julio- septiembre y ya en lo que es julio-septiembre de este ao, se estn produciendo 4.1 millones de libras para un crecimiento del 26%, que son los que estn ayudando a compensar las bajas de los otros rubros. Por otro lado, ustedes saben que el Sistema no solamente ve cifras, sino que tambin programas que se empujan de apoyo a la produccin y ya se han entregado, o se van a entregar, 1,720 bonos productivos de pesca, tanto en la Regin Autnoma del Caribe Norte como la del Caribe Sur; un total de 861 bonos en el Caribe Norte y un total de 859 bonos en el Caribe Sur, para un avance del 82% de la meta. Asimismo, se ha trabajado con el proyecto de respuesta de emergencia a los huracanes y se han realizado lneas de atencin al sector pesquero por 4.3 millones de dlares hasta alcanzar 6.3 millones de dlares, especialmente en la habilitacin a pescadores artesanales. Por otro lado, se realiza una evaluacin de lo que es la estrategia para la produccin y el fomento de la acuicultura a pequea escala. Esto consiste en embalses que se empujan desde pequeos emprendimientos. Hasta la fecha, hay 903 familias beneficiadas. Se han entregado 70,032 alevines en 911 estanques. Ya van producidas 59,551 libras, un 88% de cumplimiento de la meta, y se esperara alcanzar 67,878 libras en 963 estanques. Ese es el avance de la produccin de pequea escala y el avance de la produccin de la pesca, la cual, como mencionamos, est teniendo una tasa menor de incidencia respecto al ciclo que se produce en la produccin de pesca y acuicultura. Las exportaciones de pesca ya estn alcanzando un buen desempeo. El ao pasado se haban exportado 249.6 millones de dlares y este ao se estn exportando ya 207 millones de dlares, es decir, tratando de alcanzar la meta del ao 2023. El otro tema que abordamos durante la reunin fue la estrategia de promocin, produccin y comercializacin de miel. Como ustedes saben, el INTA est empujando la promocin y la capacitacin para el cultivo de miel. El MEFCCA, tambin el IPSA, trabajan directamente con esta estrategia. Se realizaron 12,941 capacitaciones en productores en flora de inters, elaboracin de alimentos complementarios y crianza de abejas, esto lo realiz el MEFCCA, y 201 protagonistas capacitados en la implementacin de buenas prcticas de manufactura e higiene para produccin y comercializacin de abejas, lo que impuls el IPSA. Por otro lado, 3,192 protagonistas fortalecidos en agregacin de valor a sus productos apcolas, trmites de exportacin e inocuidad de productos, actividad que la impuls el MEFCCA. Desde el IPSA, 427 protagonistas capacitados en estas prcticas, 95 muestras para monitoreo de enfermedades, 2,127 productores capacitados en produccin de miel, 23 ferias tecnolgicas municipales en las que participaron 345 productores. Y desde el MEFCCA tambin, emprendimientos que participaron en expo ferias productivas en diferentes productos; jalea, licores, gastronoma, cosmticos, artesana, etctera. Y ah, con 6,500 protagonistas atendidos desde el MEFCCA. En el inventario, se tienen 48 apiarios tecnificados instalados con 48 productores registrados, 834 colmenas, principalmente en Len, Boaco, Jinotega, Matagalpa, Rivas y Estel, y 786 productores registrados bajo el sistema de emprendimientos acucolas en el MEFCCA. En cuanto a la produccin, el total de produccin de miel alcanz las 1,036 toneladas mtricas en lo que va de 2023. El ao pasado fue de 690 toneladas a la fecha y se logr exportar 864 toneladas mtricas de miel frente a las 576 del ao pasado. Es decir, la atencin que se le est brindando de las instituciones y la promocin de la produccin de miel de abeja est teniendo los resultados esperados. Por otro lado, evaluamos la estrategia nacional de produccin de hortalizas y verduras en cultivos de enramadas, una actividad que se hace desde el INTA, tres centros especializados en produccin de hortalizas en San Isidro, Jinotega y Estel. Hay una meta anual de alcanzar 47 experimentos e investigaciones, establecidas ya en 40 experimentos. Hay un avance del 85% en investigaciones en cultivo de las diferentes hortalizas, que son bsicamente tomate, chiltoma, repollo, coliflor, pipin, ayote, cebolla, brcoli, sanda y otro conjunto de productos de hortalizas. En cuanto a produccin de plntulas, que esta es una actividad principal, poder otorgar plntulas sanas y de alto rendimiento, se tiene una meta de alcanzar la produccin de 600,000 plantas. Y hay, una buena noticia, se han producido 1,617,000 plantas en diferentes hortalizas y cultivos y enramadas, para un cumplimiento del 269% de la meta. Hay establecidas 8.42 manzanas por adopcin de semillas registradas en tomates, cebolla, chiltoma, ayote y pipin. Esas son las actividades que se impulsan desde el INTA. Tambin se trabaja en nuevas variedades de hortalizas, en 44 variedades, en alianza con centros internacionales de Costa Rica, Chile, Argentina y Mxico. Y por el otro lado, en capacitaciones, que siempre es una actividad intensa que se lleva adelante desde las instituciones, se han realizado 77,286 capacitaciones y asistencias tcnicas, un total de 5,620 servicios de trampeo en fincas de productores de hortalizas y 379 servicios de trampeo en maracuy, botn floral y 622 servicios de trampeo en moscas de fruta en el rubro de chile dulce. Por otro lado, se han realizado 2,704 eventos, entre ferias regionales y mercaditos campesinos, con la participacin promedio de 3,284 protagonistas. Esto es lo que se viene realizando desde la promocin de hortalizas, verduras y cultivos de enramadas. Por ltimo, vimos el estado de evolucin de los precios en general. Vemos que los precios han tenido crecimientos menores de los observados en el ao pasado. En promedio, la tasa de crecimiento de los precios se est acercando al 6% interanual. El ao pasado fue del 11%, es decir, tenemos la mitad de la inflacin del ao pasado. Eso es una buena noticia tambin, y los precios de los productos en estos meses, con las salidas de la cosecha, esperamos que tambin contine esa estabilizacin de precios en general. Por ltimo, el INETER hizo los pronsticos del tiempo. En la pgina web del INETER pueden encontrar toda la informacin referida al clima. Sin embargo, INETER inform que para las prximas dos semanas van a continuar las lluvias debido a un centro de baja presin que se encuentra en la costa Caribe. Sin embargo, en la evaluacin que hicimos de cmo podra afectar esto a la produccin, creemos que estas lluvias no van a afectar la produccin, ya que las cosechas comienzan despus del 15 de noviembre. Esto es en resumen lo que tratamos en la reunin del Sistema Nacional de Produccin, Consumo y Comercio y se observa un crecimiento de la actividad econmica en buena perspectiva de cierre de ao, un avance en la recuperacin de la tasa negativa de la pesca que esperaramos que finalice con una menor incidencia para lo que resta del ao, buena produccin de miel, de hecho un incremento sustantivo en la produccin de miel, y un avance en la produccin de hortalizas y enramadas con precios que tienden hacia la estabilizacin. Ese fue el resumen de la reunin. Muchas gracias! Que tengan buen da.
